comments.text: I'm 36 years old, I live in Moscow, and I've never rented an apartment. I've always lived in family properties. My mother lives just a 15-minute walk away in another family property. I understand that no one knows how much time we have left, but I want to create as many memories as possible with my mother as we grow older. However, things are a bit different in Russia. In Russia, it's not shameful to live with your parents, and no one will consider you a failure if you live in the same house as your family. You're an adult, you might have a good job, no debts, a well-maintained home, a car, and the ability to travel and have all the necessary things. So, what difference does it make where you live?
